_doc: The six topics that organize the Library. Each topic has an EN and an ES variant (the ES build reads .es). Slugs are stable URL identifiers — never rename without redirects.

topics.name: Speed & Mobile
topics.blurb: Why every second of load time costs you diners, and the 80/20 of speed work that actually moves the needle.
topics.blurb_es: Por qué cada segundo de carga te cuesta comensales, y el 80/20 del trabajo de velocidad que realmente mueve la aguja.
topics.intent: A reader landing here wants to fix a slow site, understand Core Web Vitals, or learn what mobile-first really means for a small-business website.

topics.name: Conversions & Reservations
topics.blurb: The patterns that turn a passing visitor into a booked table — and the leaks that quietly cost you bookings every night.
topics.blurb_es: Los patrones que convierten a un visitante en una mesa reservada — y las fugas que silenciosamente te cuestan reservas cada noche.
topics.intent: A reader landing here is trying to recover lost intent — fix their reservation funnel, reduce abandonment, or understand why traffic isn't converting.

topics.name: Local SEO & Discovery
topics.blurb: How Google decides which local restaurant to show — Google Business Profile, schema, reviews, and the on-site signals that matter.
topics.blurb_es: Cómo Google decide qué restaurante local mostrar — Google Business Profile, schema, reseñas, y las señales en el sitio que importan.
topics.intent: A reader landing here wants to be found in local search and the map pack.

topics.name: Operations & Margin
topics.blurb: The honest math of running an independent restaurant — delivery, pricing, prime cost, and the website's role in protecting margin.
topics.blurb_es: Las cuentas honestas de un restaurante independiente — delivery, precios, costo primo, y el papel del sitio en proteger el margen.
topics.intent: A reader landing here is making a financial decision about delivery, pricing, third-party platforms, or whether to invest in a custom website.

topics.name: Trust & Reviews
topics.blurb: Reviews, photos, response systems — the slow-compounding signals that keep first-time guests from bouncing.
topics.blurb_es: Reseñas, fotos, sistemas de respuesta — las señales que se acumulan lentamente y evitan que los primeros visitantes se vayan.
topics.intent: A reader landing here wants to build credibility — get more reviews, respond well, and surface social proof on the site.

topics.name: Brand & Design
topics.blurb: Why the website's tone, type, and palette decide whether a guest believes the food before they taste it.
topics.blurb_es: Por qué el tono, la tipografía y la paleta del sitio deciden si un huésped cree en la comida antes de probarla.
topics.intent: A reader landing here is making brand or visual decisions — Wix vs custom, colors, photography, voice.
